class.name: WorldContracts
class.brief_description: The registry of the contracts between world systems.
class.description: Hands out each contract between world systems (the weather, open water and fire; more to come), backed by the active producer node, or by a stub a test has set. Bodies that the ground, snow, plants, trees and water should feel are in the [code]world_contact[/code] group; [method describe_body] is how all of them read a body's size and weight. See docs/ideas/world-contracts.md.

method.name: add_water_stub
method.description: Adds [param stub], a script extending [WorldWater] that overrides [method WorldWater._height_at] (and what else it needs), as one more water producer beside the real ones: a pool or a sea for a test without one. [method clear_overrides] removes it.

method.name: clear_overrides
method.description: Removes every stub set or added by a test: the producers are current again.

method.name: climate_precipitation_factor_at
method.description: The terrain climate's precipitation at [param position] over its region's mean (TerrainDataMap3D's baked orographic pattern); 1 where no climate covers the point.

method.name: describe_body
method.description: How the world systems read a body: [code]center[/code], [code]radius[/code], [code]half_height[/code], [code]round[/code], [code]wheel[/code], [code]box[/code], [code]width[/code] and [code]mass[/code] (kg on the ground), from its first collision shape and its metas ([code]deform_wheel_radius[/code], [code]deform_wheel_width[/code], [code]trample_radius[/code], [code]ground_mass[/code]).

method.name: get_fire
method.description: The fire contract now: the stub a test set, else the one over every live fire producer.

method.name: get_ground
method.description: The ground contract: the stub set with [method set_ground], else the live ground's.

method.name: get_snow
method.description: Returns the snow contract every system reads: the test stub if one is set, else the built-in one.

method.name: get_stand
method.description: The stand-age contract in use: the stub from [method set_stand], else the built-in one.

method.name: get_water
method.description: The water contract now: the stub a test set, else the one over every live water producer.

method.name: get_weather
method.description: The weather contract now: the stub a test set, else the one backed by the active [WeatherMap3D].

method.name: set_fire
method.description: Replaces the fire for every system with [param stub], a script extending [WorldFire].

method.name: set_ground
method.description: Replaces the ground contract with [param stub] (a script extending [WorldGround]); the virtual methods it does not override fall back to the live ground. [method clear_overrides] removes it.

method.name: set_snow
method.description: Replaces the snow for every system with [param stub], a script extending [WorldSnow]; what it does not override still comes from the snow cover.

method.name: set_stand
method.description: Replaces the stand-age contract with [param stub] for a test; [code]null[/code] puts the built-in one back.

method.name: set_water
method.description: Replaces the water for every system with [param stub], a script extending [WorldWater]; what it does not override still comes from the producers.

method.name: set_weather
method.description: Replaces the weather for every system with [param stub], a script extending [WorldWeather]; what it does not override still comes from the producer.

signal.name: exclusions_changed
signal.description: A [WorldExclusion3D] was added, moved, edited or removed; [param area] holds its old and new bounds in metres (x, z, width, depth).
